name: hxn-gpu-webgpu
description: WebGPU for Haxe in the browser, on hxcpp and Ash compiled to wasm: devices, buffers, textures, bind groups, pipelines and command encoders
releasenote: Moves to the hxn.gpu.webgpu package, on hxn 0.3.5. Under Ash, requestAdapter fails when the browser has no adapter, and a command that throws or a browser agent that fails ends the web page with the reason.
